proposed_capability: P95/P124/Trifecta: close recurring camera drift during pixel target search. Add fail-closed camera recovery planning in existing camera_traverse, host_stack and host_listener: SAFE_REST before pixel sampling, then optional one-shot native SIM or LOT recenter and calibrated follow via game API (not uncalibrated portrait click), target-specific measured map traverse, then fresh camera_revision/capture_ref and target reacquisition. Add camera-revision/capture-bound world pixel action gate in screen_atlas so stale pixels cannot be clicked. Preserve fixed chrome behavior, exact host/presence/save admission, prevent blind follow/pan and loops.
player_save_control_impact: Recovery intent is a read-only plan unless a host adapter with explicit session, exact PID, fresh Live mode, player-idle, game-patch and scene confirmation performs a single recovery action; no uncalibrated portrait right-click, global keyhook, uncontrolled pan or game save mutation. Existing player control outranks recovery.
expected_outcome: When host sees a cursor edge, drifting/unanchored camera or stale target measurement, it blocks all world clicks, prioritizes a safe cursor rest and one-shot camera reanchor before capturing fresh target pixels; it requests observed directions for world-object traversal. World-click execution verifies target capture+camera revision after last camera action, checkpoint and exact owner before a single input; stale views refuse.
negative_tests: Cursor at edge blocks world click even if pixel box is geometrically clear
Unknown cursor or camera revision cannot authorize a pixel-based world click
Changed camera revision between plan and click forbids stale target point
New capture after reanchor required before world click
Sim vs lot centering differ; follow requires an installed game API or independently verified and calibrated portrait right-click, never fabricated native shortcut
Game camera player-owned or text field/modal blocks recovery
Target item direction only from host observation; no blind pan
After safe rest, camera revision invalidates earlier pixel coordinates
Retry count capped; no indefinite recenter or redrag
Fixed UI chrome coordinates and old click behavior preserved under original tests
No session, idle, foreground or save gate bypass
rollback_path: Revert PR; all changes confined to repository; no installed game, saves, user settings, scripts or background schedulers mutated.
unresolved_unknowns: Actual Windows Sims camera drift and native focus/camera follow need local P08 proof; cloud has no authorized live game host.
All external agent click routes need to call the enforced canonical host/world gate; this patch cannot intercept arbitrary unintegrated Playwright agents.
